title: Get paid
headline: Get *paid*
sub: Send an invoice, and match the money when it arrives.

recap.en: Nneka's outfit is ordered. Now, how does Zainab get paid?

flow.action: Folds the finished dress carefully, runs her hand along the hem, nods in satisfaction and drapes it over her arm

flow.action: Zips the finished dress into a garment bag and hangs it on the rack with a quick pleased smile
